vintage.production_notes: Harvest from 20 September to 9 October. Aged 15 months in French and Hungarian oak barrels, then a further 12 months in bottle before release.
vintage.tasting_notes: Intensely ruby red. Ripe cherries, strawberries and blackberries with violets, mallow blossoms and roses; roasted coffee and cocoa powder. Vibrant entry, layered mouthfeel, a fresh, lengthy finish of pepper, licorice and aromatic herbs.
